card.name: Words that start a clause's predicate
card.fires_on: Small words right after a subject or introducer, such as can, that, who, should, would, was, how, where the next word begins a new clause in general web text.

modes.label: Modal or verb after subject
modes.description: A modal or auxiliary verb follows its subject and the main verb comes next.
modes.example: The law<< would>> violate freedom of speech and association.

modes.label: Clause introducer
modes.description: A word like that, how or who opens an embedded clause or question after a verb or colon.
modes.example: the youngsters learned, for instance,<< how>> photovoltaics work.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words that sit between a subject and the rest of a clause, in everyday non-medical text.
